import sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tests')
from test_s3 import temporary_site, post_text, patch_data
import build
posts = {'post.md': post_text(body='old text')}
patches = {
'one.json': patch_data('one','post','old',text='new text',at='2024-02-04T00:00:00Z',why='첫 정정'),
'two.json': patch_data('two','post','text',text='changed',at='2024-02-05T00:00:00Z',why='부분 정정')}
with temporary_site(posts, patches) as root:
    content = root/'content'
    ps = build.parse_posts(content)
    pp = build.parse_patches(content, ps)
    print([(p.patch_id,p.at,p.anchor) for p in pp])
    states = {p.post_id: build.PatchState(p) for p in ps}
    for p in sorted(pp, key=lambda item:(item.at,item.patch_id)):
        print('before', p.patch_id, repr(states[p.post_id].body))
        try: states[p.post_id].apply(p)
        except Exception as e: print(type(e),e); raise
        print('after', repr(states[p.post_id].body))
PY
